Hello My name is Hachiragi.en: This sheet covers how to play matchups, items and tips & tricks against specific champions. It assumes both players are the same level with the same experience, because every matchup depends on who's piloting the champions: some people find the Mordekaiser matchup easy, others perma-ban it. It's a general guide to how each matchup should go, made to help newer players.
